Add a new alias or update an existing on:
Add a new alias or update an existing one.

The command is stored in ~/.config/al/alias.toml.

Shell flags are optional: omit all of them and the alias goes to the
"common" group, which every shell shares. Examples:
  al add gs "git status"              # no shell flag → common, all shells
  al add rmrf "rm -rf" --zsh          # zsh only
  al add rmrf "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force" --powershell  # PowerShell only
  al add o "open ." --zsh --bash      # zsh and bash only

Modify an existing alias's command and/o:
Modify an existing alias's command and/or shell scope.

Shell flags set the new scope (not additive). Omit them to keep the current scope.

Examples:
  al edit cdf 'cd ~' --fish                    # fish only, new command
  al edit cdf --fish                            # fish only, keep command
  al edit cdf --common                          # shared across all shells
  al edit cdf 'cd ~'                            # change command, keep current shells
